title: Expose durable Mission candidate review state
goal: Show the materialized candidate envelope in OTHRYS OS as reviewable evidence without allocating a canonical V2 mission ID or starting execution.
laws: Only missions/candidates/*.json is read for candidate state.
Candidate must visibly retain proposal and promotion evidence IDs.
canonicalMissionId remains null unless a later authorized mission changes it.
No new write endpoint is added.
No active mission or execution state changes from candidate display.
Tablet review remains local and touch-usable.
